name: Occupancy Region Derivation & ϵ-Intersection Criterion
definition: Defines an elliptic occupancy region Ω_i for a Gaussian kernel G_i to determine splat intersections robustly, avoiding strict binary overlap.
summary: This method defines a robust geometric intersection test for 3D Gaussian splats by deriving an elliptic occupancy region from the Gaussian kernel, replacing strict binary overlap checks with a tolerance-based epsilon-intersection criterion.
